subsystems.name: Quantum key distribution link
subsystems.role: exchanges a secret key between the wallet and a trusted node, using single photons so any eavesdropping shows up as errors.

subsystems.name: Key-distillation software
subsystems.role: turns the raw detected photon events into a shared, verified key.

subsystems.name: Wallet secure element
subsystems.role: stores the seed and signs transactions inside a tamper-resistant chip.

subsystems.name: Post-quantum cryptography engine
subsystems.role: protects everything QKD cannot: signatures, firmware updates and the wallet-to-host link.

subsystems.name: Entropy source
subsystems.role: feeds the seed generator with randomness that cannot be predicted.

subsystems.name: Tamper and power hardware
subsystems.role: keeps the device usable while resisting physical probing.

buildSteps.title: Fix the threat model first
buildSteps.detail: A quantum-encrypted wallet is only worth building if the attack it blocks is real. QKD stops an eavesdropper copying a key in transit; it does nothing against brute-forcing a weak PIN, a stolen seed phrase or a corrupted firmware update.

buildSteps.title: Choose the optical architecture
buildSteps.detail: Decide whether the wallet talks to a home base station over a short free-space or fibre link, or is only ever programmed by a QKD link and then goes air-gapped. Cold storage and a live optical port pull in opposite directions.

buildSteps.title: Build the detector module
buildSteps.detail: Single-photon detectors — superconducting nanowire or cooled InGaAs avalanche photodiodes — are integrated with timing circuits that timestamp photon arrivals to sub-nanosecond precision.

buildSteps.title: Write the protocol stack
buildSteps.detail: Implement a prepare-and-measure protocol such as BB84: the sender encodes bits in photon polarisation or phase, the receiver measures in a randomly chosen basis, and the two sides compare bases over an authenticated channel.

buildSteps.title: Distil and authenticate the key
buildSteps.detail: Sift matching events, correct errors, compress the key by privacy amplification, and authenticate the classical channel with post-quantum signatures so a man-in-the-middle cannot substitute keys.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the secure element
buildSteps.detail: Bind the distilled key into the wallet's key hierarchy so transaction signing requires both the device secret and keys only obtainable over the quantum link.

buildSteps.title: Harden the physical package
buildSteps.detail: Add mesh shielding, voltage and temperature sensors, and response circuitry that wipes keys on intrusion, then evaluate against a formal protection profile.

buildSteps.title: Test against a real adversary
buildSteps.detail: Run detector-blinding, Trojan-horse and timing attacks in the lab and confirm the error rate rises detectably — the whole security argument rests on that.

prerequisites.why: fibre QKD links are commercially deployed in metro networks and by banks and governments, though not at consumer cost or size.
efficient detectors exist but are bulky, costly or need cryogenic cooling, which fights with a pocket-sized device.
NIST finalised lattice-based key encapsulation and signature standards in 2024; these, not QKD, carry most of the practical quantum-resistance.
QRNG chips are sold commercially and already suit a small hardware device.
putting sources, interferometers and detectors on one photonic chip is the only plausible route to an affordable consumer unit.
QKD keys cannot travel beyond roughly a hundred kilometres of fibre without intermediate trusted nodes.

pathway.milestone: QKD deployed in metro fibre networks and dedicated government and banking links
pathway.unlocks: proof that quantum key exchange works operationally, if not cheaply.
small, low-power modules that could fit in a handheld device.

pathway.milestone: hybrid post-quantum and QKD custody systems for high-value institutional holdings
pathway.unlocks: layered defence where the cost of a link is justified by the assets protected.

pathway.milestone: consumer quantum-encrypted wallets, only if QKD hardware becomes a cheap commodity
pathway.unlocks: a niche product; for most users, post-quantum cryptography in an ordinary secure element solves the same problem more simply.
